degree_two_half_lattice_correspondence.basis_transport: For a chart parity p in the certified parent M17 basis, its degree-two orbit mask is mask(p * B^{-1} mod 2), where B is the retained degree-two row LLL change to the parent basis.
degree_two_half_lattice_correspondence.interpretation: This is an exact label correspondence of torsors. The short rational-bisection shell is not thereby a deep-centre or visibility theorem.
degree_two_half_lattice_correspondence.same_finite_set: The degree-two divisor translation action w -> w+2x and the pointed-chart centre action Q -> Q+2x are both M17/2M17.

boundary: Every target is a known public rank-31 point combination, used only retrospectively.
The output does not claim a global minimum reduced coordinate: unvetted parity classes can have a better coordinate because a PGL2 reduction has chart-dependent distortion.
The degree-two M/2M bijection labels divisor translation orbits. It does not construct all bisection equations or identify a split fibre.
The residual seven are a deterministic strict integral complement, not a canonical arithmetic splitting of D/M24.

metric.warning: The rounded metric is an exact finite decision metric, not an exact canonical-height pairing.
